text:
Priya: Heads-up — with the year-end hiring blitz we have several contractors converting mid-December and a few start dates clustered around the company shutdown. Need clarity on: contractor->FT conversion accruals, carryover for sick/PTO, and one-off exception approvals for prebooked travel during blackout windows. Jamie: Quick Q — do contractors get any carryover when they convert or is everything pro-rated from the FT start date? Omar: I'm converting 2024-12-20, booked travel 12/27-12/30. Worried blackout will nuke my PTO. Rach: Hiring ops note: we sometimes see conversions overlap the shutdown. Curious if People Ops has a standard for crediting or pro-rating contractor days on conversion. cc @Priya Priya: Short answer: contractors do not automatically transfer contractor PTO into the FT balance. Policy is to pro-rate FT accruals from the official start date. However, People Ops can approve one-time credits in exceptional cases (e.g., accepted offer with prebooked non-refundable travel). Priya: Blackout specifics: company shutdown dates are 2024-12-24 to 2024-12-26 and 2024-12-31 to 2025-01-01 (no approvals). 2024-12-29 to 2024-12-30 are soft-blackout — approvals are limited and need explicit manager+oncall coverage signoff. HR Bot: HR policy page: <https://redwood.example/hr/pto-year-end> HR Bot: Exception form: <https://redwood.example/hr/pto-exception> Required fields: name, employee id (or contractor id), conversion date (if applicable), dates requested, manager approval screenshot, backup coverage plan, and any supporting docs (offer letter, receipts). HR Bot: Example request body to paste in the form: ``` Subject: Exception request — Omar (contractor -> FT) Dec 27-30 prebooked travel
Name: Omar
ID: C-1427
Conversion date: 2024-12-20
Dates requested: 2024-12-27 to 2024-12-30
Reason: Prepaid non-refundable travel booked before offer accepted.
Attached: booking confirmation and offer letter.
Manager approval: attached screenshot from "Ava (Eng Manager)"
Backup coverage: Pager rotation swap with Priya/Marcus on 12/27-12/30 ``` Jamie: If People Ops approves the credit, how many days can we expect to be credited? Is there a cap? Priya: Typical one-off credit is up to 5 days PTO for these scenarios, but we review case-by-case. If conversion is within 7 days of shutdown we prioritize and can fast-track approval. Please attach proof of travel or non-refundable costs. Rach: Approval workflow for soft-blackout days: manager + oncall lead signoff in form -> People Ops review -> Eng Director sign-off if >3 days or if it impacts sprint deliverables. Jamie: Who's the oncall lead we should list? (so we can pre-fill approvals) Priya: For Eng infra team list Marcus; for Platform list Lee; for SRE list Ana. If you don't know, add the rotation owner and we'll route. Omar: Filing the exception now with booking PDF and offer. Tagging Marcus for coverage swap. Priya: Got it — I'll batch-reviews tomorrow morning and aim to respond within 3 business days. If anyone else is converting or has prebooked travel overlapping shutdown, please ping me directly or fill the form. :thumbsup: Rach: Noted — I'll include this guidance in the pre-offer checklist for any Dec hires so candidates are warned about blackout windows. Priya: Also reminder to managers: if you approve an exception, add that approval screenshot to the form. We can't process without it. Omar: Thanks all, appreciate the quick answers. Priya: np — will update the People Ops FAQ page after approvals so it's explicit for next year.
